entities.summary: Eleonora "Lola" Ter-Parsegova-Makhviladze was a Georgian-Armenian politician of the Social Democratic Party and member of the Constituent Assembly of Georgia from 1919 to 1921. After the Soviet takeover of Georgia in 1921, she was part of an opposition underground and later worked as a teacher.
